ns2:course.label: Introduction to Innovation, Leadership and Engineering Entrepreneurship
ns2:course.description: Introduction course to innovation, leadership, and engineering entrepreneurship as a field of study. The student will learn about innovation and leadership, professionalism and ethics, hear from guest entrepreneurial lecturers, and tour innovative/entrepreneurial spaces. While working in small teams, students will pitch a problem, develop solutions, learn to work as a team, and hone their written and verbal presentation skills.
